observations: Single photo shows a black game console standing on its side, wrapped in what looks like a clear plastic/cling film over part of the casing.
Visible rear ports: power input, USB-type connector, HDMI, Ethernet/LAN, and a vent slot pattern consistent with a slim-style game console body.
One black controller (DualShock-style, PlayStation logo visible on the controller face) sits in front of the console with a coiled USB charging cable.
No power brick, power cable, HDMI cable, or box is visible in the photo.
No serial number, model sticker, or UK/US regional label is legible in the image.
The seller's text is truncated after 'extra pad is...' so the full claim about a second pad cannot be read.
